# GeoTIFF Int16 Small

<div class="gc-badges">

A small single-band GeoTIFF stored as signed 16-bit integers. Tests that raster loaders and downstream code preserve medium-range integer dtype semantics without silently widening or converting values.

## What this case checks

Confirm that signed 16-bit integer rasters open with the correct dtype and preserve their declared numeric storage type through simple reads.

## Risk types covered

- [`dtype/coercion`](../risk/dtype-coercion.md)
- `dtype/range_assumption`
- [`nodata/ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `32633` |
| `expect_nodata` | yes |
| `expected_shape` | `[10, 10]` |

## Notes

### Purpose

Single-band `int16` raster for validating signed integer raster dtype handling.

### What to expect

- CRS is `EPSG:32633`.
- One band (`int16`).
- NoData is `-9999`.
- Pixel values exceed `int8` range to make accidental narrowing visible.

## Required capabilities

- `load`
- `dtype-check`
- `nodata-check`
